responseText:
**There are 7 continents.**

The standard model taught worldwide is:

- Africa
- Antarctica
- Asia
- Europe
- North America
- South America
- Australia (Oceania)

Some systems merge Europe and Asia into **Eurasia** (6 continents) or combine North and South America into **the Americas** (also 6). A few models count **Oceania** as a continent instead of just Australia.

The 7-continent model remains the most common in education and general use.
